data.text:
P.K. Saish Babu vs The State Of Telangana on 9 September,
2024
Author: B. Vijaysen Reddy
Bench: B. Vijaysen Reddy
 Honourable Sri Justice B. Vijaysen Reddy
 Writ Petition No.24807 Of 2024
Order : 
(ORAL) This writ petition is filed by the petitioner seeking to declare the action of respondents No.5 to 7 in interfering with his personal liberty pursuant to the notification No.602/FSS-1/2024 dated 24.05.2024, issued by respondent No.3 - the Commissioner of Food Safety, Telangana, as being illegal, arbitrary and contrary to the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, the Food Safety and Standards Rules, 2011 and also contrary to the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Act, 2003.
2. Mr. R. Laxmikanth Reddy, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home, basing on the written instructions dated 06.09.2024, submitted that so far, there is no complaint registered/pending against the petitioner with respondent No.7 - the Station House Officer, Alwal Police Station. It is submitted that respondent No.7 never harassed, threatened, interfered, raided or seized the petitioner's products nor has taken any coercive action against him. 
3. A copy of the written instructions is served on the learned counsel for the petitioner. 
4. As it is stated that there is no interference of any kind by respondent No.7, no further orders are required to be passed. The writ petition is disposed of. There shall be no order as to costs. 
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous applications, if any, pending in the writ petition, stand closed.
